crosswalks.historical_boundary: Broad Catalonia principality/modern-region envelope; no audited rural-only polygon for the 1290-1329 population estimate.
crosswalks.resolution_method: No region selector is treated as an audited medieval rural boundary. The record remains explicitly rejected until a historical boundary and urban/rural decomposition are mapped.

area_comparison.area_method: No geometry match; no area substitution.
area_comparison.area_difference_policy: No target, capacity or population is area-rescaled.

crosswalks.notes: Exact missing evidence: historical rural polygon, quantified boundary coverage, and boundary-matched population/pressure interval.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Mallorca island; exact geographic outline is known, but the available population estimate does not separate Palma/port from the rural food system.
crosswalks.resolution_method: No EU5 location tag is currently accepted as the island's audited 1301-1329 rural footprint. Even with an island match, imported Atlantic wheat and urban/port population would block training.

area_comparison.area_method: Historical island area recorded for audit; no EU5 geometry match.
area_comparison.area_difference_policy: No target, capacity or population is area-rescaled.

crosswalks.notes: Exact missing evidence: closed rural/urban decomposition, import-adjusted local-food share, and saturation interval.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Distributed Bali subak/watershed catchments; no single 1100-1500 aggregate polygon reconstructed.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Placeholder selector intentionally yields no EU5 rows. A watershed/subak polygon and historical population interval must be reconstructed before mapping.

area_comparison.area_difference_policy: Physical validation cannot be converted to an aggregate target.

crosswalks.notes: Exact missing evidence: dated population/capacity interval, saturation/pressure evidence and historical boundary polygon.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Polonnaruwa and adjacent Sri Lankan dry-zone tank cascades; no closed rural aggregate polygon reconstructed.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Placeholder selector intentionally yields no EU5 rows. Tank-system polygons, dated population and shock-separated pressure evidence are required.

area_comparison.area_difference_policy: Physical validation cannot be converted to an aggregate target.

crosswalks.notes: Exact missing evidence: closed tank-cascade boundary, population interval, local-food share and saturation interval independent of abandonment/war.
